notes.title: Funko Fusion is Steam Deck Verified!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we've got good news!

We’ve been listening, we’ve been watching and we have something 
exciting to share!

We are pleased to announce that Funko Fusion is Steam Deck verified! 

We have been hard at work behind the scenes in the last six months to 
get to this point and we’re thrilled to be able to get that green tick on our
profile!

So, if you’re new (hello, and welcome!) or if you’re just catching up on 
the news, why not fire up your Steam Deck and dive straight into the 
action? With more new DLC on the horizon and extra characters to play 
as, there’s no better time to jump into either single player or Co-Op!

When you log in, you'll notice we've curated two frame rate target settings - 30fps and 40fps. These settings do not lock your frame rate on the Deck, but will ensure the games graphics settings are optimized to hit those frame rates.

For those of you on Proton 9, if you're running into any issues, we recommend you switch to Proton 8 when playing Funko Fusion on the Steam Deck.

As always, let us know what you think, leave us a review – and keep your 
eyes peeled for new DLC coming real soon!

notes.title: Online Co-Op Is Out NOW! New Characters Join The Roster!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We know you've been patiently waiting for online co-op, and we can't say thank you enough for the patience!

Online co-op is exiting beta and rolling out for all players in the main branch of the game and so we're happy to say that online co-op is  OUT NOW!.

With the launch of co-op, players can dive into three of the core worlds from Funko Fusion!
 Jurassic World
 Hot Fuzz
 Battlestar GalacticaWhile we're excited to bring you these worlds, we're working hard to release the rest of the core and cameo worlds as well, which will be coming soon!

How to start a co-op game:
Find the multiplayer machine on any of the levels in the hub below the top floor. Note that to use this machine, you need to have completed the Tutorial and need to have finished at least one level in the game. Use the machine to start a multiplayer lobby.

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44095158/4fd4047ec707063f8019d390438a33c0c72725aa.jpg

How to invite friends:
We recommend inviting friends, or joining friends’ games, via the Steam friends list. Hover over a name in your friends list in Steam, then click the drop-down arrow to see “Invite to Game” or “Join Game”

When you are in the Multiplayer Lobby, you can also use the in-game system by walking up to 3 of the 4 purple Pop! Boxes and using them to view your Steam friends list to invite a friend.

With a controller: Navigate to your friends and invite them to the game. They will receive an invite via Steam and an icon will appear to show an invite has been sent..

With a mouse & keyboard: navigate to your friends and click on their names to invite them.

notes.title: Steam Co-Op Beta Now Available!
notes.content:
We are working on getting co-op ready for release, and we’d love to get your input! 

If you own Funko Fusion on Steam, you can try out a new multiplayer beta for an early look at online co-op today. This beta is a work in progress and there are still some bugs we are working on, but your feedback will be valuable to help us test online functionality and performance with a larger group of players.

Important: 
As this is a beta version of the game, we recommend not playing the single-player levels while you are opted into the multiplayer beta on Steam.

How to opt in to the multiplayer beta:
Go to your Library and find “Funko Fusion”
Right click on Funko Fusion and click on “Properties”
Select “Betas” on the left in the Properties window
Click on the drop-down box in the top right, then select “multiplayer_beta”

After closing the window, the Steam will look for an update which is required to try out the online co-op beta. If you do not see an update available after 5 minutes, restart the Steam client.

If you want to return to the regular game for single-player, you can use the same method above to opt out by selecting “NONE” in the “Betas” menu.

Note: if you do not see any multiplayer_beta in the drop-down box, restart the Steam client.

How to start a co-op game:
Find the multiplayer machine on any of the levels in the hub below the top floor. Note that to use this machine, you need to have completed the Tutorial and need to have finished at least one level in the game. Use the machine to start a multiplayer lobby.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44095158/4fd4047ec707063f8019d390438a33c0c72725aa.jpg

How to invite friends:
We recommend inviting friends, or joining friends’ games, via the Steam friends list. Hover over a name in your friends list in Steam, then click the drop-down arrow to see “Invite to Game” or “Join Game”

When you are in the Multiplayer Lobby, you can also use the in-game system by walking up to 3 of the 4 purple Pop! Boxes and using them to view your Steam friends list to invite a friend.

With a controller (recommended): navigate to your friends and invite them to the game. They will receive an invite via Steam and an icon will appear to show an invite has been sent..

With a mouse & keyboard: navigate to your friends and click on their names to invite them. There is a visual bug in this menu where an invite icon does not appear when clicking on a friend’s name.


Backup your save:
Because this is a beta, we recommend making a backup of your save game. There should not be an issue using your existing save game but as this is a beta, we want to make sure you don’t lose any progress inadvertently.

Find your save location by using the above steps to go to Properties, then go to Installed Files and click “Browse…” to find your installation folder.

The save game file is located in the following location in your Steam installation folder:
\steamapps\common\FunkoFusion\FunkoFusion\Saved\SaveGames

Copy the file PlayerSaveData.sav to another location to back it up. Copy it back in case you run into any issues while playing the beta.


Online co-op content:
Co-op content and functionality:
The online co-op beta includes two Worlds: Jurassic World and Hot Fuzz.

Cameo Levels and Cameo Quests are not available co-op.

When you die in a co-op session, any other player can revive you. You can also collect Funkoins, which can be used to unlock special Blacklight skins!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44095158/b74fd77633843854c082fb99c40349ec20fdd2e2.jpg

Press the Middle Mouse Button or click the Right Stick on a controller to place a waypoint marker for other players to rally towards.


Reporting issues:
Help us test this beta by leaving your feedback in the dedicated Discussions Thread in the Community Hub!

We look forward to seeing our first players play online while we remain hard at work on online co-op for all platforms!

notes.title: Quality of Life Update #1 - Less Hard, Faster, Better, Stronger
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Thank you for all the feedback since launch! With your help, we were able to quickly identify and fix some of the technical issues and bugs that popped up, and we are on the constant lookout for new bugs to squash as they get reported.

We’ve also heard you loud and clear that you want to have more fun playing Funko Fusion, so this is our first of several major updates with changes that will improve your experience.

In this update, we are making changes that will allow you to access Worlds and characters much faster than before, and we are reducing some of the stress of combat by re-balancing enemy and boss encounters across various levels.

First of all, Worlds can now be unlocked much faster! Players can now move onto a new World after completing one level, instead of previously needing to complete every level in a World. Completing one level in any World will also unlock all of that World’s base characters. You can now also use any unlocked character in any level immediately, breaking canon and mashing up franchises from the get-go!

Second, our goal has always been for you to have FUN, and we feel like we missed the mark at launch. As such, we are going back through the entire game, using community feedback as our guide, to re-balance combat and pacing to remove any unintended frustrations. In this Quality of Life update, you’ll notice we’ve made the effort to reduce excessive enemy spawning and, overall reduce the amount of enemies that could lead to you being overwhelmed in various parts of the game. Combat should be challenging at times, but never frustrating! We’ve also made changes that reduce backtracking throughout the game and reduce chances of you running into soft locks. 

As we’re making these changes, we love to keep hearing about things that you like, and things that you don’t. We will continue working on Quality of Life updates that improve the flow and pacing, increase the fun factor of the game, and remove anything that stands in the way of you, our players, having fun, which is the most important part of this journey! Alongside these changes we are hard at work on Co-Op mode which will also benefit from all these changes.



Patch Notes

Gameplay Adjustments

GLOBAL

 After completing the tutorial intro level, players can now select and play as any unlocked character in Story Mode by using the Golden Pop! character selection box inside any level, or via the Golden Pop! boxes in the Hub after completing the first level. Inside any level, melee the Character Pop! Box to cycle to the Golden Pop! Box and then select your character of choice.
 Players can now unlock all four base characters of a World by completing the first level of that World.
 Players can now unlock the second World for only one Golden Crown, earned by completing one level. The cost for unlocking the second World Door has been reduced to two Golden Crowns, and so forth.
 Hub flow has been adjusted to direct new players to unlock a second World after finishing the first level of the first World.
 Crown Buy Machines in levels now require less vinyl to produce a Silver Crown. Spend the vinyl freely on items and Golden Chests and experiment with random weapons and gadget combinations!
 Players are no longer interrupted by hits or shots when drinking a Soda.
 Increased the speed of drinking a Soda buff.
 Players are now invulnerable while using CCTV monitors.
 Players are now invulnerable while using Mould Machines.
 Increased player lives from 3 to 5.
 Added additional save data redundancy to prevent save game data loss from occurring.
 Adjusted text when a player is a ghost to better inform them to proceed to a Pop! Box.
 Reduced sprinting stamina cost by half, allowing Players to sprint twice as long.
 Added green crosses to the heart pickup for better visual clarity.
 Adjusted the brightness of hologram locations for items the player needs to place to help draw attention to them.
 Adjusted the UI for level screens so that the Cameo IP can be more easily seen and help players see where the Cameo levels are in the game.


WORLDS

 Rebalanced the Zombie Foxxo boss fight.


Masters of the Universe

Rebalanced the entire encounter.

 Rebalanced the entire level.

Funko Fusion launches TOMORROW, September 13th! Here at 10:10 Games we’re excited to finally get the game in your hands! Check out the map below to find out what time the game launches in your region:

Last Call For Pre-Orders!

As a part of the launch celebration, Players who pre-purchase Funko Fusion will receive The Walking Dead Pack for free!

The Walking Dead Pack features:
- Rick Grimes playable character.
- Rick Grimes "Leader" variant outfit.
- Michonne playable character.
- Michonne "Traveler" variant outfit.

If you're holding off on purchasing the game, no worries! The Walking Dead Pack will be also available for purchase after the pre-order period.

Don't forget, all Funko Fusion Players on Steam can also claim the the Team Fortress 2 Pack for FREE!

You've Been Promoted To Colonel!

In case you missed it, we've announced that KFC Colonel Sanders has joined the Funko Fusion roster and will be unlockable for all players at launch via an in-game mission!

[previewyoutube=DyfgskECXYQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Steam Deck Update!

We've seen feedback from Steam Deck players who are eager to jump into our festival of fandom as well, and for that, we're incredibly thankful! We have Steam Deck fans in our studio as well.
Funko Fusion will not be officially supported on Steam Deck at launch, but we will be working to optimize the game for Steam Deck post-launch. We don't have an exact date for you just yet, but rest assured that we want to welcome Steam Deck players into the worlds of Funko Fusion with a great experience on Deck!

Thank you Steam Deck community!

That's all for now! We're looking forward to launching Funko Fusion tomorrow and we can't wait to invite you into the Wonder Works Factory for the first time!

- The 10:10 Games Team

notes.title: Developer Update - Launch, Co-Op, and Beyond
notes.content:
As we are preparing for the launch of Funko Fusion, we want to provide an update from our development team at 10:10 Games about online co-op, what to expect at launch, and beyond.

[previewyoutube=110Yr_IsSq8;full][/previewyoutube]

Funko Fusion will launch September 13th on Steam with the full single-player experience!

While the team is working hard on polishing online co-op, we will release a series of post-launch updates that include free bonus characters and outfits, and will enable co-op world by world starting with Jurassic World in October and all worlds available for co-op play in November.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44095158/d4b1270125ab08c3776b9bfd03f998f0634cf4b8.jpg

We’re thrilled to be launching our first game as 10:10 Games and we are so excited to support the community that’s building around Funko Fusion! Stay tuned to our social channels for future updates!

notes.title: 22nd August - Funko Fusion patch notes
notes.content:
In our latest patch, we have implemented the following fixes:

- Improved audio cues to help with finding huskies
- Performance improvements to kennel area
- Added melee hint prompt for intro enemy when it's stunned
- Stability fixes to mould machine to prevent lock out
- Stability fixes for cutscenes to aid with freezing / low framerate.
